author: Coding agent (authoring pass)
why: REQ-22: partner files sometimes carry a negative subtotal by mistake. Order Import accepted such a row, so it became an order of minus 500 cents.
before: The row A-3,-500,0 imports as an order of -500 cents.
after: The row A-3,-500,0 is rejected with a clear error, like a row with a missing column.
preserve: A valid row still imports at its discounted total, and a zero subtotal is still allowed.
approach: In parseOrderRow(), after the existing number checks, throw when the subtotal is below zero. importOrder() calls parseOrderRow(), so every imported row gets the check.
alternatives: Clamp a negative subtotal to zero. Rejected: it would hide a broken partner file instead of reporting it.
rollback: Revert the PR commit. No data migration.
